SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Special Branch - S1 Station,
REPORT
Date October 28, 1937.
Subject Frank DEL RIO - Report from French Police regarding
disappearance of.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by

With reference to the contents of the attached French
Police Report dated October 16, 1937 relating to the alleged
disappearance of Frank DEL RIO, American, I have to state that
enquiries reveal that the whole incident appears to be the
brainchild of Mrs. Vera KOZLOWSKY'S imagination.
DEL RIO, against whom nothing of a detrimental nature is
known locally, has been employed by Mr. Jimmy JAMES, the owner
of Jimmy's Kitchens and of the now defunct St. George's Cabaret
and Radio Station RJOK, since 1932. When the radio station
operated DEL RIO acted as announcer, electrician and general
handyman, and since its closure has been doing odd jobs in
Shanghai, Hongkong and Chefoo at his employer's branches in those
ports.
About a year ago he was offered a post with a Chinese
radio station in Shanghai that was contemplating conducting
part of its programme in English, but nothing ever came of this
proposition, and as far as can be ascertained this particular
station was in no way connected with the Chinese Goverment.
DEL RIO left Shanghai for Chefoo on September 19, 1937
on the s.s. "Shengking" in order to take over the management of
Jimmy's Kitchen in Chefoo from Mr. JAMES, who, a few days
previously, had returned to Shanghai. DEL RIO was obliged to
leave at short notice in order to catch the steamer. As for
the 'friend' mentioned in the French Police Report, this person
was none other than Mr. JAMES himself, who paid his employee's
rent in advance because he himself was not certain when DEL RIO
would be returning, since the closing down of his Chefoo
establishment for the winter is contingent with the leaving of
all American warships there.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号
特别分部 - S1 分站，
报告
日期：1937年10月28日。
事由：弗兰克·德尔里奥（Frank DEL RIO）——关于其失踪的法国警方报告。
制作人：D.S. 皮茨（Pitts）。转发人：

关于所附1937年10月16日法国警方报告中涉及美国人弗兰克·德尔里奥（Frank DEL RIO）据称失踪一事，经调查表明，整个事件似乎纯属维拉·科兹洛夫斯基夫人（Mrs. Vera KOZLOWSKY）的臆想。
在当地，并未掌握任何对德尔里奥不利的情况。自1932年以来，他一直受雇于吉米·詹姆斯先生（Mr. Jimmy JAMES），后者是“吉米厨房”（Jimmy's Kitchens）、现已停业的圣乔治歌舞厅（St. George's Cabaret）以及RJOK广播电台的所有者。在广播电台运营期间，德尔里奥担任播音员、电工及一般杂务人员；自电台关闭以来，他一直在其雇主位于上海、香港和烟台的各分支机构从事零散工作。
大约一年前，曾有一家计划部分节目使用英语播出的上海中文广播电台向他提供职位，但此事最终未成。据查，该电台与中国政府毫无关联。
德尔里奥于1937年9月19日乘坐“盛京”号轮船（s.s. "Shengking"）离开上海前往烟台，以便从詹姆斯先生手中接管烟台“吉米厨房”的管理工作。詹姆斯先生已于数日前返回上海。德尔里奥因需赶乘轮船，不得不仓促启程。至于法国警方报告中提到的那位“朋友”，此人正是詹姆斯先生本人。他预先支付了雇员的租金，因为他自己也不确定德尔里奥何时返回，因其烟台产业冬季停业取决于当地所有美国军舰的撤离。
